title: Arriving in Washington in February 1935; Pete Jones marries Irma
summary: Phillips came to D.C. with Red Elkins and drummer-vibist Bill Thompson; Pete Jones followed in 1936, having married Irma Young in 1927 for about a year.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Anyway, you came in February of '35 to D.C. Who was with you at that time?
Red Elkins and Bill Thompson, a drummer. He was also a vibraphone player -- he played vibraphone with Earl Hines' band, the last big band that Earl had.
Yeah, '47, '48, something like that. He lives in Chicago now. Bill Thompson. Hell of a drummer, and he plays vibes, too. Quit playing drums, started playing vibes.
What about Pete Jones? When did he come to D.C.?

Yeah. When we didn't down there with him... We left him in Wichita. See, Pete was on his way to go down to see her then. But he got to thinking. If they're going down there to Texas... So we got out of there in Wichita, and went back to Salina, Kansas.
